name: Agent evolution
intent: Change what an agent is, with enough independent evidence that the change is an improvement rather than a fit to its own benchmark.

steps.name: Identify the weakness from telemetry, not from intuition
A mutation hypothesis that could be disconfirmed
Build the candidate, with its lineage recorded
Run it without touching production behaviour
The suite the mutation was aimed at
Tasks that were not visible during generation
steps.note: A benchmark gain with a flat holdout is the Goodhart signature. Quarantine.

steps.name: Attack the measure on the candidate's behalf
steps.note: This role did not write the candidate and may not modify the evaluator.

steps.name: Record the lineage, including the failures

escalations.when: benchmark improves and holdout does not
escalations.note: Not a retry. The candidate is archived as a failure with its lineage.

escalations.when: the candidate would change the constitution, trust levels, gates or the security policy
escalations.note: An evolution run may propose such a change and may never land one.
Evaluator changes carry separate provenance and separate review.

completion: every stage present, in order, none skipped
no single collapsed score — the fitness stays a vector
failed candidates archived with their reasons
promotion approved by a role that did not author the candidate
evaluation: did promoted candidates hold up in production use, measured by the same task family
